description: restore_snapshot rejects a board plan snapshot that seats an occupant member_boards does not name, with INCONSISTENT_SNAPSHOT. Cross-language lock for the HEU-750 reverse membership check. Before it, only member_boards was walked, so this payload was accepted, add_member treated the occupant as a new enrollment and seated them a second time, and both positions cycled off one enrollment. The payload spells out the BoardPlanEngine shape by hand, so a new required field on the engine, a board, or the config turns this into a deserialization failure rather than the rejection it tests.

error.message_contains: member_boards does not put them on that board
